original.question: Dacă protecţia motoarelor contra suprasarcinilor este realizată cu întrerupere, dispozitivul de comutaţie trebuie să întrerupă obligatoriu:

cases.exact_scope: Motor overload protection *if* the protective action disconnects, decide which conductors must be interrupted
cases.before: §5.3.1.7.2 first demands protection from excessive heating for motors >0.5kW with special exception for fire pumps and other must-run services.
cases.central: When disconnecting for overload, source states interrupt all active conductors, then immediately qualifies that interrupting the neutral is NOT compulsory.
cases.after: §5.3.1.7.2.2 distinguishes thermal protection for abnormal winding temperature, including faults cooling or rotor blocking.

option_gate.A: Literally resembles first source sentence 'all active'; if active includes N, the following neutral exception means A is too strong as a universal obligation.
option_gate.B: Neutral alone is not mandatory and not adequate to drop all phases.
option_gate.C: Interrupting all phase conductors is the minimum obligation supported when neutral may remain connected; likely intended answer under the exception.

cases.reason_for_not_official: Original A copies a partial source sentence, while following sentence limits its literal universally mandatory implication; ambiguity depends on term 'active conductors' including N.

original.question: Pe un circuit   care alimentează mai multe receptoare electrice de putere de aceeaşi natură şi destinaţie

ABC.A: nu se prevede protecție comună la scurtcircuit
ABC.B: nu se prevede protecție comună la suprasarcină
ABC.C: se prevede protecție la suprasarcină dacă puterea totală instalată a acestor receptoare  depăşeşte 16 kW

cases.exact_scope: Same-purpose/same-nature multiple power receivers on one feeder; distinguish shared short-circuit protection from per-motor overload protection
cases.central: §5.3.1.1 starts separate circuit per power receiver, with a narrow exception: shared short-circuit protection of several receivers of same nature and purpose where TOTAL installed power does not exceed 15kW.
cases.after: §5.3.1.2 accounts for simultaneous normal/starting loads; §5.3.1.7.2 requires individual motor overheating protection for motors >0.5kW, with special uninterrupted safety loads exception.

option_gate.A: Saying no common short-circuit protection conflicts with explicit permission for <=15kW in the appropriate regime.
option_gate.B: No common OVERLOAD protection is not the assertion in §5.3.1.1. Motor overheating protection per motor does not automatically prove a categorical prohibition of common overload protection.
option_gate.C: 16kW threshold and mandatory overload action are NOT derived from the explicit 15kW SHARED SHORT-CIRCUIT clause. Different value and protection object.

cases.reason_for_not_official: No source matched A/B/C uniquely under the exact legal engineering action. A short-circuit permission <=15kW cannot prove mandatory overload for >16kW.
